statement: Eight benchmark instances have independently implemented feasibility/cost checks for LaCAM3 witnesses and 56 bounded repair runs. Local route gains exist; selected policy failed held-out primary superiority.
status: Author-checked local candidate archive; local intake open; scientific acceptance pending.
scope: Four-neighbor discrete point agents on 32x32 benchmark grids, 64–256 agents, static goals, fixed recorded search allowances; no novelty, optimality or physical robot claims.
reproduce_full: python tools/prepare.py; python tools/run_trial.py (in a copy; native deadline runs may differ)

assumptions.statement: LaCAM3 and local random-neighborhood repair are substantive baselines but are not an exhaustive current-state-of-the-art comparison.
Selected proximity heuristic did not improve the primary held-out aggregate; fresh validation needed.
